profile.name: Adhithya Babu
profile.tagline: Full-stack developer crafting modern web experiences
profile.bio: I'm a MERN stack developer with a passion for building full-stack web applications that are clean, performant, and purposeful. I work across the entire stack — from designing REST APIs and database schemas to crafting responsive React UIs. Lately I've been diving deeper into AI/ML integrations, bringing intelligent features into real-world products.

projects.title: AI-Powered Mental Health Companion
projects.subtitle: Emotion-aware chatbot with DistilBERT
projects.description: An intelligent chatbot leveraging a fine-tuned DistilBERT transformer for real-time emotion detection. Features a lightweight Flask backend for fast inference and integrated text-to-speech accessibility.

projects.title: AgileSpace
projects.subtitle: Kanban project management tool
projects.description: A robust project management tool with an interactive Kanban-style task board. Built with decoupled architecture, strict MVC design patterns, and secure JWT-based authentication.

projects.title: College Placement Portal
projects.subtitle: Multi-role recruitment management system
projects.description: A multi-role web application streamlining campus recruitment. Implements role-based access control for Students, Admins, and Recruiters to manage profiles and job application flows.

projects.title: Expense Tracker
projects.subtitle: Real-time financial tracking app
projects.description: A clean financial tracking app for logging income and expenses. Focuses on efficient React state management to deliver real-time balance updates and simple budgeting tools.
